description: EXPERIMENTAL: detailed Wizzair flights for exact dates with fare bundles (Basic/WIZZ Go/WIZZ Plus — base, discounted and WDC price per bundle, flight numbers, exact times). This endpoint sits behind Kasada bot protection and may return a rate-limited error — fall back to wizzair_search_timetable or wizzair_search_fares when it does. Data comes live from Wizzair's private booking API (unofficial — may briefly fail if Wizzair rotates or throttles it).

arrival_station.description: Arrival airport IATA code (3-letter, e.g. BCN).

departure_station.description: Departure airport IATA code (3-letter, e.g. WAW).

no_cache.description: Force a fresh Wizzair fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

return_date.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one-way.

wdc.description: Price with the WDC membership discount. Default TRUE for this tool.

name: wizzair_search_flights
title: Wizzair flights with fare bundles (experimental)
